messages.subject: getting information from index.html to server.R
parts:
Hello every one,

i have difficulties in comprehension of the mechanics (index.html  <---> server.R), in the tutorial they said that the inputs we can get them by their html names and the render the output by the html ids, i want to get the value of   this radio to upload an file:

<input type="radio" name="fileSeparator" value='comma'> comma <br/>
<input type="radio" name="fileSeparator" value='semicolonne' checked> semicolonne <br/>
<input type="radio" name="fileSeparator" value='tab'> tab <br/>


in server.R:
sepa <- reactive({
fileSeparator <- switch(input$fileSeparator,
                   comma=',',
                   semicolon=';',
                   tab='\t',
                   exp = rexp,
                   )
  })

output$tab <- renderTable({
        fileSeparator <- input$fileSeparator 
        inFile <- input$fileChoice 
        if (is.null(inFile)) 
           return(NULL) 
 read.csv(inFile$datapath, header=TRUE,  sep=fileSeparator , dec='.', row.names=NULL)
 })
but it not work, if i change my sep from fileSeparator to ';' i have no problem???

any ideas or examples about this subject( i am very interested in shiny but with html interface) are welcome ???

regards
